mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% in two consecutive monthly releases
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) in at least 3 out of 5 tightening episodes after the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the correlation between UNRATE drops and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during such episodes, or the mechanism fails in more than 40% of recession foreshadowing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals a broad-based slowdown in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >0.5% in a single month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered industrial production contraction months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month averages signals a monetary policy tightening coinciding with rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 12-mo avg AND CPIAUCSL > 12-mo avg in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 6 out of 10 such co-occurring episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of more than 100,000 jobs, combined with a concurrent decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals an overheating labor market that precedes a policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 100,000 AND UNRATE falls in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which drags on construction-related equities and broader market sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-mo moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during at least 3 out of 5 such housing weakness episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A positive sequential revision to real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) in two consecutive quarters signals upward surprise in demand growth, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 revised up in two consecutive quarterly releases
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 4 out of 6 upward-revision episodes.
